headline: Nothing reveals AI earbuds, Ear (note), ahead of December 8 launch
summary: Nothing detailed its upcoming AI earbuds, the Ear (note), ahead of their December 8th release. The buds can record calls, while the charging case can record, transcribe and summarize conversations via a microphone-equipped 'Talk' button.
